about_the_game:
BECOME A LEGEND
Step into the boots of a young talent and carve your path to football immortality. Club Legend is the ultimate first-person career simulation where every decision, every touch, and every word shapes your journey from unknown prospect to global superstar.

FULL FIRST-PERSON FOOTBALL MATCHES
Experience the beautiful game like never before — right from the pitch. Play matches in full first-person, feeling the intensity of every sprint, tackle, and goal. Hyper-realistic physics and immersive match presentation make every game feel like a live broadcast.

LIVE THE LIFE OF A FOOTBALLER
This isn’t just about matchday. Manage your lifestyle, interact with teammates, managers and agents, respond to interviews, and make choices off the pitch that impact your reputation, fan perception, and career opportunities.

DEEP WORLD SIMULATION & TRANSFERS
Play in a living, breathing football world with dynamic leagues, authentic transfers, managerial changes, and evolving club fortunes. Rise up the ranks, request transfers, negotiate contracts, and chase glory across the globe.

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYER & CAREER
Design everything from your appearance and position to your playstyle and personality. Grow from raw talent into a seasoned pro by working hard, staying disciplined, and making your mark on world football.

TRAIN LIKE A PRO
Boost your attributes through interactive first-person training drills. Improve your pace, shooting, passing, dribbling and more to become the complete player — or specialize in your own unique style.

EDITOR & CUSTOM DATABASE SUPPORT
Want to rewrite football history? Build your own world with full database editing — create leagues, clubs, logos, players, kits and more. Start a career in any universe you can imagine.

INTERACTIVE RELATIONSHIPS & REPUTATION SYSTEM
Your words matter as much as your performances. Interact with teammates, coaches, fans, press and agents. Earn trust, spark rivalries, gain sponsorships, and build a reputation that precedes you on and off the pitch.

THE JOURNEY IS YOURS
From grassroots to greatness, fight for your place, overcome adversity, and write your legacy. Will you be a loyal one-club hero or a globe-trotting superstar? A disciplined professional or a controversial headline maker?

This is your moment. Your career. Your legend.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Intel Iris Xe – 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatibel
  • Additional Notes: May change in the future
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 – 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatibel
  • Additional Notes: May change in the future

short_description: Make your dreams come true and become a professional football player: Create your player, sign for your favorite clubs and score bangers against their biggest rivals. Play your ultimate football career you want to have in the most realistic first person football career mode game!
